Container.Name: Allo
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted family shopping list. Offline-first PWA: the list works with the network off and reconciles when it comes back.
All state lives in one /appdata volume - the SQLite database and the cookie encryption keys. Back up both together, and never delete the keys: losing them logs every family member out.
On first run only, Admin__Username and Admin__InitialPassword create the first account, which must change its password at first login. Leave them set or clear them afterwards; they are ignored once an account exists.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The app listens here. On br0 with its own IP this is the port Nginx Proxy Manager forwards to.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database AND the data protection keys. Both must survive a container update. Back this whole folder up.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: First account, created only when no account exists yet.

Config.Name: Admin Initial Password
Config.Description: Temporary password for the first account. Minimum 8 characters. The app forces a change at first login.

Config.Name: Admin Display Name
Config.Description: Name shown on the first account, e.g. your first name.

Config.Name: Reverse Proxy Address
Config.Description: Nginx Proxy Manager's IP address. Without it the login rate limiter treats the whole family as one client, and the auth cookie is never marked Secure. Only this address is trusted to set X-Forwarded-For, so leave it blank if nothing proxies to this container.

Config.Name: Login Attempts Per Minute
Config.Description: Failed logins allowed per client address per minute before a 429.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Leave this alone unless you are moving the database. It must stay inside the App Data volume.

Config.Name: Data Protection Keys Path
Config.Description: Where the cookie encryption keys live. Leave this alone: if it ever points outside the App Data volume, every container update logs the whole family out.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone for log timestamps. Stored timestamps are UTC regardless, so this only affects the log.
